crossRefs.note: The man, the master of the house, went out to them, and said to them, “No, my brothers, please don’t act so wickedly…

people.name: Lot
people.line: Abraham's nephew; rescued from Sodom's destruction

translations.web: Lot went out to them through the door, and shut the door after himself.
translations.bsb: Lot went outside to meet them, shutting the door behind him.
translations.kjv: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,
translations.asv: And Lot went out unto them to the door, and shut the door after him.
